name: Death To Self
overview: Scripture teaches that death to self involves a deliberate denial of personal desires and ambitions, embracing daily the cross as Jesus instructed in Luke 9:23. This process requires a believer to diminish their own will so that Christ may increase within them, as expressed in John 3:30. The metaphor of a grain of wheat dying to produce abundant fruit (John 12:24) illustrates that true spiritual life and fruitfulness come through this self-denial. Romans 6 emphasizes that believers are to consider themselves dead to sin but alive to God, affirming that grace is not a license to continue in sin but a call to live in newness of life through union with Christ’s death and resurrection.
